caption:
Growth or decay? Just compare b to one.

800(1.25)ᵗ grows 25% per step; 800(0.75)ᵗ loses 25% per step. Multiplying by more than 1 grows, by less than 1 shrinks.

Follow @samsonsatprep for daily SAT tips.

youtube.title: Exponential Growth vs Decay: Compare b to 1
youtube.description: In y = a·bᵗ, b > 1 means growth and 0 < b < 1 means decay. Example: 800(1.25)ᵗ grows 25% per step and 800(0.75)ᵗ decays 25% per step.
